fixed_by: none (analysis only; report does not modify code)
root_cause_summary: Team agent rebuild is all-or-nothing: one teammate ACP warmup failure triggers kill_and_wait on every already-attached agent and returns 400, so the whole team never starts (aionui-team service.rs:1476-1484, present in v0.1.48 and v0.1.50). The underlying failure reason (codex ACP handshake cause) is flattened to an opaque 'Invalid request: ACP error' (provisioning.rs:390 + protocol/error.rs suppresses stderr and SDK default messages). Also: SIGKILL to process group fails with Operation not permitted, leaking processes.
evidence: app 2.1.37 -> aioncore v0.1.48. Screenshot shows Codex CLI red error badge on '正在唤醒团队'. Logs show repeated 'team agent rebuild attach failed ... Invalid request: ACP error' for codex(gpt-5.5) and codebuddy(gemini), all-or-nothing cleanup, 400 on POST /session, infinite retry.
fix_direction: In target repo aionCore off latest main via worktree: (1) tolerate partial team rebuild success; (2) propagate structured ACP/CLI failure cause into surfaced error + feedback.runtime.* fields; (3) fix process-group SIGKILL Operation-not-permitted cleanup.
